class.name: CgameGPUMatrixDB
class.brief_description: GPU compatibility matrix and rendering-regression database.
class.description: [CgameGPUMatrixDB] ingests JSON reports written by a GPU benchmark run (collected from testers), builds a matrix of vendor, GPU family, driver and renderer cells, detects visual regressions, clusters failures by driver and exports Markdown, CSV and learned data for [CgameGPUSettingsDB]. [b]Report format.[/b] A report is a dictionary with [code]schema[/code] ([code]1[/code]), [code]system[/code] (non-empty strings [code]adapter[/code], [code]vendor[/code], [code]driver[/code], [code]os[/code], [code]renderer[/code]; no personal data), an optional [code]completed[/code] flag and [code]runs[/code]: one entry per quality level with [code]level[/code], [code]frame_ms[/code] ([code]p50[/code], [code]p95[/code], [code]p99[/code]), [code]errors[/code] and [code]checksums[/code], one 16-digit hexadecimal perceptual hash per captured frame. [b]Regressions.[/b] For every renderer, level and frame index the reference is the medoid of all reported hashes (or a hash pinned with [method set_reference]). A frame whose Hamming distance from the reference exceeds [member tolerance] is a regression and blocks that level. The hash is the 64-bit difference hash (dHash) from [method dhash]. A report fails when it has errors, a regression or [code]completed = false[/code]. Analysis is rebuilt lazily after changes.

method.name: add_report
method.description: Validates and adds a report. Invalid reports are recorded in [method get_rejected] with [param source] and [code]false[/code] is returned.

method.name: build
method.description: Recomputes the references and the evaluation of every report. The accessors call this automatically when needed.

method.name: cells
method.description: Returns the matrix cells sorted by [code]vendor|family|driver|renderer[/code]. A cell has [code]vendor[/code], [code]family[/code], [code]driver[/code], [code]renderer[/code], [code]reports[/code], [code]pass[/code], [code]fail[/code], [code]reasons[/code], [code]level_p50[/code] (median per level), [code]max_level_60fps[/code] (highest level meeting [member target_ms], or [code]-1[/code]), [code]status[/code] and [code]perf[/code].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all reports, rejections and pinned references.

method.name: csv_escape
method.description: Quotes [param text] for CSV output if it contains a comma, a quote or a newline.

method.name: dhash
method.description: Returns the 64-bit difference hash of [param image] as 16 hexadecimal digits: the image is converted to greyscale, resized to 9x8 and every pixel is compared with its right neighbour. Returns an empty string for an empty image.

method.name: driver_failures
method.description: Returns failures grouped by vendor, driver and renderer, worst ratio first. Each entry has [code]vendor[/code], [code]driver[/code], [code]renderer[/code], [code]total[/code], [code]fails[/code], [code]ratio[/code], [code]families[/code], [code]reasons[/code] and [code]driver_specific[/code], which is [code]true[/code] when at least half of the reports fail while another driver of the same vendor and renderer mostly passes.

method.name: evaluations
method.description: Returns the evaluation of every report: adapter, vendor, family, driver, renderer, status ([code]"pass"[/code] or [code]"fail"[/code]), reasons, regressions, worst distance, [code]level_p50[/code], [code]level_p95[/code] and the blocked levels.

method.name: get_rejected
method.description: Returns a message for every rejected report or file.

method.name: get_reports
method.description: Returns the accepted reports.

method.name: hash_distance
method.description: Returns the Hamming distance (0 to 64) between two hashes, or [code]-1[/code] if either is not 16 hexadecimal digits.

method.name: ingest_dir
method.description: Ingests every [code]gpu_report_*.json[/code] file of [param dir_path] and returns how many were accepted.

method.name: ingest_file
method.description: Reads and adds one JSON report. Returns [code]false[/code] if the file is missing, is not JSON or fails validation.

method.name: learned_data
method.description: Returns [code]adapter (lower case) -> {level: [frame ms, ...]}[/code] in the layout of [code]user://gpu_learned.json[/code]. A level that rendered incorrectly or errored is recorded as 1000 ms so that [method CgameGPUSettingsDB.recommend] never picks it.

method.name: regressions
method.description: Returns every frame whose hash is further from the reference than [member tolerance], with [code]adapter[/code], [code]driver[/code], [code]renderer[/code], [code]level[/code], [code]index[/code] and [code]distance[/code].

method.name: set_reference
method.description: Pins a known-good hash for a renderer, quality level and frame index. It overrides the medoid of the reports.

method.name: to_csv
method.description: Returns the matrix cells as CSV text with a header row.

method.name: to_markdown
method.description: Returns a Markdown report with the matrix table, driver failures, rendering regressions and rejected reports.

method.name: validate_report
method.description: Returns the problems of [param report]. An empty array means that the report is valid.

method.name: write_learned
method.description: Writes [method learned_data] as JSON to [param path] so that [CgameGPUSettingsDB] can use it. Returns [code]false[/code] if the file cannot be written.

members.member: Maximum Hamming distance, out of 64 bits, for two frames to count as the same image.
Frame time budget used to decide the highest level that runs at 60 FPS.

constants.constant: Length of a perceptual hash in hexadecimal digits.
Number of samples kept per adapter and level in the learned data.
